_source: Figure 1 of Marraffini et al. 2024, digitised from Kahane et al. 2018 Figure 7 (pixel offsets over 198 px per scale point). The spread value is the plotted error bar read in the same units; it is treated as a standard error, the stricter reading: the test multiplies it by sqrt(N) to get the standard deviation. Lay population from Kahane et al. 2018 study 1, where 1.20 and 1.22 are standard deviations (spread_is on that entry).
